featTitle.text: Tính năng mới — học từ Baby Tracker, Huckleberry, Nara

flowNote.text:
Play screen 1 to try every flow:
• Hút sữa → hết giờ → chọn bên → nhắc lần sau → Home shows “Lần trước”
• Rã đông sữa → Tắt → hạn dùng sữa (chip on Home)
• Nấu cháo → 3 bước tự chạy nối tiếp
• Clock button on Home → Lịch sử
• “Cả nhà cùng thấy” switch on Set screen
Demo speed: 1 phút mỗi giây (Tweaks).

n10.text: 2 · Smart next reminder (like Huckleberry SweetSpot): suggests the next time from her own recent gaps. One big Nhắc tôi button; ± moves it 15 min.

n11.text: 1 · History: the top card answers the 3 a.m. question — when did I last pump, which side. Below, today's timers with who started them.

n12.text: 3 · Shared family timers: Bà's phone gets the same Live Activity when Mẹ starts cháo. Anyone can pause; Tắt cho cả nhà stops it on every phone.

n13.text: 4 · Use-by timer: starts automatically when thawing ends. Limits shown (2 h out, 24 h fridge) are placeholders — confirm against CDC / Bộ Y tế guidance before shipping.

n14.text: 5 · Step timers for ăn dặm: cháo runs Ngâm → Nấu → Để nguội as one chain; each step rings softly and the next starts. Bước tiếp skips ahead.

n5.text: Leaving the app: the running timer becomes a Live Activity. The Dynamic Island shows only the category icon (left) and time left (right) — no words to read.

n6.text: Long-press the Island: it expands with big round Pause / Stop buttons that work without opening the app (App Intents).

n7.text: Lock screen: the same Live Activity as a soft card — time left, end time, progress and two round buttons. The system counts down on its own, so nothing breaks if the app is closed.

n8.text: Time's up: scheduled with AlarmKit (iOS 26+), so it rings full-screen even on Silent or in a Focus. One big Tắt button plus +5 phút; soft sound that rises gently.

n9.text: 1 · Auto history: when pumping ends, the Done screen asks one tap — Trái / Phải / Cả hai. That tap is the whole log. Skip is always allowed.

outTitle.text: Khi mẹ rời app — Dynamic Island & màn hình khóa

n15.text: 6 · Language: gear on Home → Cài đặt → Tiếng Việt / English. Switches every screen instantly, including past History entries. Each option is written in its own language so anyone can find theirs.
